physics_goals.quote: A high statistics search for neutrino oscillations at the 2,800 MW Bugey reactor with the detectors at 15, 40, and 95m
physics_goals.value: Search for reactor antineutrino oscillations by comparing positron spectra at 15, 40 and 95 m from a 2,800 MW reactor, and measure the antineutrino flux and spectrum at short distance

summary.plain: A series of experiments at the Bugey nuclear power plant in France in the early 1990s that measured reactor antineutrinos from 15 to 95 metres away. Bugey-3 compared three identical detectors at different distances and found no oscillation; Bugey-4 gave a very precise rate measurement.
summary.technical: Short-baseline reactor antineutrino experiments at the 2,800 MW_th Bugey reactor: Bugey-3 used three identical 600 l, 98-cell 6Li-loaded (0.15 %) liquid-scintillator detectors at 15, 40 and 95 m (about 1.5e5 events), giving the most stringent limits near delta m^2 ~ 1e-2 eV^2 of its generation; Bugey-4 was a 2,000 l water-target integral flux measurement at 15 m (1.4 % accuracy).
